implemented: Offline workflow catalog with candidate, reviewed, active and deprecated lifecycle states.
standardized is an active-workflow property and never a separate lifecycle state.
Discovery requires an explicit selected path list and verifies every path against the local Git tracked set.
Discovery reads only selected files, recognizes explicit metadata markers and records duplicate structures as review-required candidates.
Exact scan replay is byte-stable and performs zero writes.
Candidate activation requires review; high-risk activation requires approval, schema and tests.
Standardization additionally requires a stable version, examples, schema and tests.
Revision, merge and deprecation preserve immutable workflow IDs, supersedes links and replacements.
Catalog validation is integrated into the strict local state gate.
Workflow CLI exposes discover/list/review/activate/revise/merge/deprecate/validate without external catalog or network access.
